channel.description: BBC News - World এর সর্বশেষ খবর

item.title: [BBC News - World] What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
item.description: Six people were killed in a random shooting in Krakow's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.

item.title: [BBC News - World] Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike
item.description: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.

item.title: [BBC News - World] 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
item.description: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

item.title: [BBC News - World] Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
item.description: Neither PM Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor that of his rival secured a majority in last week's election.

item.title: [BBC News - World] US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
item.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

item.title: [BBC News - World] UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
item.description: The former Brexit negotiator says EU countries would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules "a la carte".

item.title: [BBC News - World] Paraguay's former president charged after bank collapse
item.description: Santiago Peña was ousted due to a banking crisis which left millions of people unable to access their money.

item.title: [BBC News - World] Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
item.description: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

item.title: [BBC News - World] Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data
item.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.

item.title: [BBC News - World] Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
item.description: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
